title: Bloodsoaked Blade
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Bloodsoaked Blade}}

'''Bloodsoaked Blade''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that replaces Mana Burn and all related mechanics on [[tincture]]s with Weeping Wounds, draining [[life]] instead.

==Mechanics==
Weeping Wounds does the following: {{c|help|Weeping Wounds cause you to lose 1% of your Life per second per stack. Tinctures deactivate when you have 1 life remaining.}}

It is possible to use this keystone in synergy with {{psl|id=eternal_youth_keytone2692}} to greatly increase amount of Weeping Wounds, if you're able to avoid taking damage to your life pool.

==Location==
Bloodsoaked Blade lies on the bottom right side of the tree, between the Duelist and Ranger locations.
